description: This file defines the 'OrderItem' entity class, mapping to the 'order_item' table in the database. It models individual items within an order, including fields for identifiers, product details, quantity, price, and timestamps for creation and updates.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an order line item with mappings to the database columns, including lifecycle callbacks for setting timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order item.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates this order item with an order.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the product.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the product.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product.

methods.name: getUnitAmount
methods.description: Returns the unit amount (price) for the product.

methods.name: setUnitAmount
methods.description: Sets the unit amount (price) for the product.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when this order item was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when this order item was last updated.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Callback method to initialize UUID and timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Callback method to update the 'updatedAt' timestamp before updating the entity.
